title: Predict integer division
description: Create your own small C# experiment comparing division with integer operands and decimal operands. Predict each result before running it, then explain any difference.
hints: What types do the operands have, and what result do you predict?
Try values that do not divide evenly, and inspect the resulting type.
The operand types determine which division operation C# uses. An integer result cannot retain a fractional part.
Experiment outline: choose operands; predict type and value; observe both; change one operand type; compare observations.
